svg.text: Economy · Soft currency, hard currency & purchase states
Module 05 · Sheet 3/3 · 17 states in this module · 390 × 844 mobile frames
Gold upgrades cards; Gems refill tickets, speed chests and buy explicit exchanges. Prices are illustrative. External checkout always returns verified entitlement or a recoverable pending state.
Numbered controls match the route rail beside each phone. Arrows lead to destination screen IDs. Dashed paths are system outcomes, not player buttons.
